PVGIS 5.3 ERA5 typical meteorological year at 22.30 N, 114.17 E
Source output acquired 2026-10-11; source period 2005-2023.

Produced by the European Commission, Joint Research Centre, PVGIS 5.3,
using ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis. PVGIS data source and service citation:
Huld, T.; Paietta, E.; Zangheri, P.; Pinedo Pascua, I. (2017):
Typical Meteorological Data access service. European Commission,
Joint Research Centre [Dataset]. DOI: 10.2905/JRC.FDTQ22G.

The JRC catalogue authorizes reuse with source acknowledgement under the
European Commission reuse notice. PVGIS-specific usage conditions place
no restriction on use of the supplied information. Retain attribution and
identify modifications when redistributing these data. This notice does
not relicense unrelated EPW files, third-party materials or branding.

Original EPW SHA-256:
60719262a01e8827e8984537800f97f508ab4ae5ae8abc55fce571893c55b2d8
Original bytes are unchanged. A separately identified GreenLens canonical
EPW changes the hourly minute marker from 0 to 60, trims CSV whitespace,
removes any UTF-8 BOM and uses LF. It changes the singular HOLIDAYS/DAYLIGHT
SAVING header to Radiance's required plural SAVINGS spelling. Source
values and years are retained.
Source-profile interpretation: greenlens.pvgis_tmy_epw_midpoint.v1.

hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present. C3S Climate Data Store.

This is reanalysis-derived typical weather, not a weather-station record,
forecast or certification dataset. The original city/country/station
unknown markers and unused-field quality warnings must remain visible.
